commit.message:
test(motion): held probe of the stock-ring level for the HSM plan

An ignored probe, not a pin. It builds the center area of one level of
the user's D plate in the 70 x 70 stock as the 3-D ladder builds it, and
prints what the HSM plan does with each piece and with the whole level.
Held work for the effort:max follow-up.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(motion): air-side stock ring planner for the adaptive pocket

Round A of #1950. plan_from_air cuts the stock ring of a level from
the air side: fronts are inward offsets of the stock outline by one
step width; closed fronts join as a ramped spiral, fronts broken by
the part wall are cut as open runs with measured lead-ins (a run is
cut short where no lead-in holds the load), then two offset wall laps
and the outline lap. Raster::open_air opens the air band. The raster
walks move to raster/walk.rs (400-line rule, no logic change).

Not wired into hsm_passes yet (round B). Pinned by the four air_rings
tests on the user's D plate: worst load 0.1538 = the limit, rest 0,
10537 moves.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(motion): route the stock outline to the air-side ring planner

Round B of issue #1950 (plumbing only).

- open_sides takes a stock band; stock_band(r, adaptive) gives 2r +
  OPEN_SLACK for Adaptive and the old r - OPEN_SLACK for every other
  strategy (computed exactly as before).
- New entry pocket3d_open_prev; the stock argument goes through
  ladder, plan_level (None on the wrap), adaptive_passes and
  hsm_passes.
- hsm_passes plans a piece that reaches past the stock from the air
  (plan_from_air), the material clipped to the stock; a plan over the
  load bound is refused by name (degree compare, 1e-9 slack, as
  lift::keeps) and the level goes to the Offset rings, said.
- The probe becomes pins: the stock ring level reaches the air
  planner, no stock keeps the growth spiral, an overloaded air plan
  is refused by name.

No app arm calls the new entry yet: posted G-code does not change.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(app): whole-model Adaptive 3D Pocket plans its stock ring from the air

The Adaptive plain ladder of a whole-model 3D Pocket now reaches
stock_band(r, true) past the stock and calls pocket3d_open_prev with
the stock outline. Shell, rest and Multi-Axis Rough keep the old band.
Pinned by a_clamp_in_the_air_band_blocks_the_post: steel in the air
band is struck and the post gate names it.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(motion): microlift joins for the air-side stock ring plan

plan_from_air joins each pass to the one before it by the existing
LinkLaw (straight chord, return over the retract plane, or a lead whose
graze joins the pass). Each join is walked again on the stock in pass
order and its readings go into the worst load. A pass with no proved
join keeps its retract hop.

D plate, R 5: hops 45 -> 3 (budget 8); worst load unchanged at
0.153760. The stock-ring level test now asserts hops <= HOP_BUDGET.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(motion): air entry plunge and fixture refusal for the air band

The Adaptive air plan enters each level by an axial plunge at the start
of its first pass where the tool's disc is proved clear of the stock
outline (machining2d::in_air); else the old entry law runs. A tool that
is not centre-cutting keeps its old entry.

Generation refuses a whole-model Adaptive 3D Pocket by name when a
tagged fixture meets the air band (operation::AIR_BAND_FIXTURE), with
what the user can do. The post gate stays the second line.

Pins: the_air_plan_enters_by_a_plunge_outside_the_stock,
a_clamp_in_the_air_band_refuses_the_adaptive_op_by_name,
a_non_adaptive_whole_model_keeps_the_old_band,
the_stock_ring_level_plans_adaptive_with_no_budget_note,
the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level (heavy lane).

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(motion): hold the stock ring Adaptive pin for round E

The pin reads red: through adaptive_passes the D plate stock ring plan
crosses itself at (-8.12, -35.61) and the level falls back to Offset
rings by name. The crossing law is not changed. Round E owns the fix.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): the air-side stock ring plan never crosses itself

Round E of issue #1950. The D plate level through adaptive_passes
crossed itself at (-8.12, -35.61). The bare air passes had 40 crossing
pairs before the joins (spiral vs first open runs, run vs next-front
run, runs vs wall laps); the joins added none.

adaptive::air_uncross drops each chord of a new pass that crosses a
kept pass (guard::crosses, the plan's own law) and goes on as a new
piece, read on the stock as before. A late join whose grown lead
crosses another pass falls back to the next law or the retract hop.
The crossing check, load check and budgets are unchanged.

Reading: no crossing, but 23 retract hops (budget 8), so the level
still goes to Offset rings by name. Both D plate pins are ignored with
a round F reason.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(motion): move the descent's landing spots to descent_place

descent.rs was 427 lines. The helpers that say where an entry lands
(wall margin, spots along the first pass, the helix placement, the
plunge spot) move to machining3d/descent_place.rs with no change of
logic; descent.rs posts the motion (327 lines).

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(motion): read how each air ring pass is reached (round F)

The probe `probe_air_hops` lists each pass of the D plate air plan and
its join. Each of the 21 open runs is reached by a retract hop: its
start stands beside the last front, where the rim (r + 1.5 cells)
reads the wall at about 25 deg, over the 15 deg bite. A landing in air
stands past the last front's path, and the lead-in then crosses it.
Two lead-in changes were tried and reverted (31 hops and no change).
The two D plate pins stay ignored, now with the round G reason. No
check, budget or golden is changed.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(motion): cut the air ring's open fronts region by region (round G)

The runs of consecutive open fronts in one region form a chain
(adaptive::air_chain). Each chain is cut whole. A run on its chain is
reached on the floor: back along the run just cut to the vertex where
the new run start's normal meets it, and its lead-in starts there, so it
only touches that path. Else a feed chord read within the load bound and
the crossing law; else the joins as before.

D plate stock ring level: 23 retract hops before, 10 now (budget 8),
worst load 0.1538 unchanged, refused None. The 7 hops left are wall lap
pieces split where a lap meets a front run end. The two D plate pins stay
ignored. No check, bite, rim or budget changed.

Refs #1950

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(decisions): record the round H reading of the air ring hops

Round H tried to stop each open front run at the outermost wall lap so
that no lap meets a run end. The laps became whole, but the first lap
then reads 0.2437 of D (bound 0.1538) where the first open front runs
almost parallel to the part wall. The trim is not kept. The plan stays
at 10 retract hops (budget 8); the two D plate pins stay ignored with
the round H reason. No check, bound or budget changed.

fix(motion): restore the imports and arguments that the main merge needs

Main's find_clear_helix (c505b2ed3) uses along_pass, lattice,
disc_clears, dive_room and bore_meets_lifted_leg, which this branch
moved into descent_place or stopped importing. Import them again.

Main's pocket3d_mask_edge tests call open_sides with four arguments;
this branch adds stock_band. Pass stock_band(r, false), which equals
the old band (r - OPEN_SLACK), so no expectation changes.
